executive_summary.headline: Section E clone rationalization COMPLETE at 17/17 (100%). Scope was 1 Certified clone (P1-E-051), not the expected 37 — prior sessions already handled the other 16.

scope_comparison.program_expected_source: S803 session summary §9: '37 Certified clones — learner-safety priority'; Agent D learner-safety assessment: '~37 Certified Section E items across ~8 template-rotation clone groups'
scope_comparison.gap_explanation: Prior sessions (S701-S710, S803) already archived 16 of 17 Section E clones. The 9 Certified items identified as clone-group members by Agent B's inventory are the SEED items (E-037, E-038, E-040, E-041, E-042, E-043, E-045, E-048, E-053, E-056) — these are unique-topic items or first-instance seeds, not redundant clones. Agent F's seed selection confirmed this: 4 of 5 clone groups were already fully archived (G1-G4: 16 clones already Archived); only G5 had 1 remaining Certified clone (P1-E-051, sibling of seed P1-E-043).
scope_comparison.dual_block_discrepancy_note: Agent B's inventory and Agent D's learner-safety assessment used a different clone-group mapping than Agent F's seed selection. Both stem from the same DL-016 +1 offset in the dual-block architecture — different agents read different metadata/content blocks and assigned different QIDs to the same group concepts. This is a known scan artifact (DL-016, DEFECT_LIBRARY.md). Agent F's function-constructor parse is the authoritative methodology.
scope_comparison.verdict: The 37-item estimate was an overestimate caused by (a) stale SESSION_STATUS data listing 16 Pack A clones as 'excluded' rather than 'Archived', (b) DL-016 scan artifacts conflating seed items with clone siblings, and (c) counting clone-group seeds as clones rather than unique concept representatives. The actual clone surface was 1 Certified item.

dl_016_discovery.source: Agent D — raw-source inspection of P1-E-036/P1-E-037 dual-block architecture
dl_016_discovery.finding: 100% of Pack A Section E dual-block items carry DL-016 metadata-block ExplanationWrong shift. Confirmed: P1-E-036 metadata EW fields describe P1-E-035's topic (cash-receipts custody controls) while P1-E-036's content-block stem is a different topic (purchase authorization thresholds). +1 offset confirmed.
dl_016_discovery.scope: All 75 Pack A Section E items (dual-block architecture applied to entire section). 58 Certified items affected. 177 distractor ExplanationWrong slots (58 items × 3 distractors each) potentially describe wrong-topic feedback.

learner_impact.mechanism: When a learner selects a wrong answer on a DL-016-affected Section E item, the distractor explanation displayed comes from the PREVIOUS QID's topic — not the item the learner answered. The feedback addresses a completely unrelated control concept.
learner_impact.exposure: 58 Certified items in the learner delivery pool. Every wrong answer selection on these items produces educationally misleading feedback.
caqs_violations: CAQS §4.3 EV4: Distractor explanations must be choice-specific — impossible when EW text describes a different item's choices
CAQS §4.2: Explanations must identify the specific misconception — the learner receives the wrong misconception entirely
CAQS §11.2 LS2: Error correction — learner cannot self-correct because feedback addresses the wrong topic

dl_016_discovery.cross_reference: DL-016 entry in DEFECT_LIBRARY.md. First documented Session 64 (2026-07-24) as 'Pack A Section E only — 5 items.' Session 64 pilot expanded scope to ALL Pack A sections. Now confirmed at 100% per-A-section-E-item (all 75 items) by Agent D's raw-inspection methodology.
dl_016_discovery.why_not_caught_earlier: DL-016 was initially classified as Informational/Low severity when the scope appeared limited to ~5 items. The Session 64 expansion to all-Pack-A-sections was documented but not acted upon because: (a) the learner pool was not fully certified at the time (fewer Certified items = lower exposure), (b) the P0 blocker was DL-008 (67 items, now refuted by S801 as DL-029 false positives), and (c) no agent had performed raw-source inspection of Pack A Section E items to confirm the 100% rate. Agent D's methodology (line-level metadata-block-vs-content-block comparison) was the first to confirm universal scope.
